about: Questions an operator actually asks /recall, each with the document that answers it — and, for questions about a detail inside a long document, the section. Worded the way someone half-remembers a decision; a question that repeats the document's title only measures string matching. Revised 2026-09-15 after an ai-eval-engineer review found four questions copying title words and none reaching past a document's first section. Used by tests/lib/recall-golden.test.mjs.
